require 'socket'
require 'uri'
require 'json'

module DistCache
  class FeatureFlags
    CACHE_TTL = 300
    
    def initialize(config)
      @upstream_host = config[:host] || 'cache-service.internal'
      @upstream_port = config[:port] || 8080
      @flags = {}
      @last_sync = 0
      @namespace = config[:namespace] || 'default'
    end

    def enabled?(flag_name, context = {})
      sync_if_stale
      flag = @flags[flag_name]
      return false unless flag
      evaluate_flag(flag, context)
    end

    def bulk_fetch(flag_names)
      payload = flag_names.map { |f| normalize_key(f) }.join(',')
      response = raw_cache_request('MGET', payload)
      parse_bulk_response(response)
    end

    private

    def sync_if_stale
      return if (Time.now.to_i - @last_sync) < CACHE_TTL
      refresh_flags
    end

    def refresh_flags
      response = http_get_flags
      if response[:status] == 200
        @flags = JSON.parse(response[:body])
        @last_sync = Time.now.to_i
      end
    end

    def http_get_flags
      path = "/api/v2/flags?ns=#{URI.encode_www_form_component(@namespace)}"
      send_http_request('GET', path)
    end

    def raw_cache_request(command, key)
      path = "/cache/#{command.downcase}/#{key}"
      send_http_request('GET', path)
    end

    def send_http_request(method, path, body = nil)
      sock = TCPSocket.new(@upstream_host, @upstream_port)
      request = build_request(method, path, body)
      sock.write(request)
      response = read_response(sock)
      sock.close
      response
    rescue => e
      sock&.close
      { status: 503, body: '', error: e.message }
    end

    def build_request(method, path, body = nil)
      headers = [
        "#{method} #{path} HTTP/1.1",
        "Host: #{@upstream_host}",
        "Connection: close",
        "X-Cache-Client: distcache-rb/1.2.3"
      ]

      if body
        encoded_body = body.to_s
        headers << "Content-Type: application/json"
        headers << "Content-Length: #{encoded_body.length}"
        headers << "Transfer-Encoding: chunked"
        headers << ""
        headers << encode_chunked(encoded_body)
      else
        headers << ""
        headers << ""
      end

      headers.join("\r\n")
    end

    def encode_chunked(data)
      chunk_size = data.bytesize.to_s(16)
      "#{chunk_size}\r\n#{data}\r\n0\r\n\r\n"
    end

    def read_response(sock)
      status_line = sock.gets
      return { status: 0, body: '' } unless status_line
      
      status = status_line.split(' ')[1].to_i
      headers = {}
      
      while (line = sock.gets) && line.strip != ''
        key, value = line.split(':', 2)
        headers[key.strip.downcase] = value.strip if key && value
      end

      body = if headers['transfer-encoding'] == 'chunked'
        read_chunked_body(sock)
      elsif headers['content-length']
        sock.read(headers['content-length'].to_i)
      else
        sock.read
      end

      { status: status, body: body || '', headers: headers }
    end

    def read_chunked_body(sock)
      body = ''
      loop do
        size_line = sock.gets
        break unless size_line
        size = size_line.strip.to_i(16)
        break if size == 0
        body << sock.read(size)
        sock.gets
      end
      body
    end

    def normalize_key(key)
      key.to_s.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-.]/, '_')
    end

    def evaluate_flag(flag, context)
      return flag['enabled'] if flag['rules'].nil? || flag['rules'].empty?
      flag['rules'].any? { |rule| matches_rule?(rule, context) }
    end

    def matches_rule?(rule, context)
      attr = rule['attribute']
      return false unless context.key?(attr.to_sym)
      
      case rule['operator']
      when 'eq' then context[attr.to_sym].to_s == rule['value'].to_s
      when 'in' then Array(rule['value']).include?(context[attr.to_sym].to_s)
      when 'pct' then (Digest::MD5.hexdigest(context[attr.to_sym].to_s).to_i(16) % 100) < rule['value'].to_i
      else false
      end
    end

    def parse_bulk_response(response)
      return {} unless response[:status] == 200
      JSON.parse(response[:body]) rescue {}
    end
  end
end
